Reason: The chest X-ray shows a mass in the right lower lung zone (indicated by the arrow) and a soft tissue density overlying the lateral right chest wall consistent with a breast mass. Anatomically, the breast mass is located laterally relative to the medial lung tumor, and this pattern is classically suggestive of metastatic spread from a primary breast carcinoma to the lung.
